findings.location: Paragraph in Part 2: "No one can overextend themselves indefinitely... Symptoms of overload can include lack of sleep, strained relationships, procrastination, fear of failure, and a susceptible immune system."
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the nuance of "susceptible" as vulnerability/weakness rather than "sensitivity". For example, replace «ευαισθησία του ανοσοποιητικού συστήματος» with «ευάλωτο/αδύναμο ανοσοποιητικό σύστημα» to match the source meaning.

findings.location: Paragraph in Part 2: "Overload tends to drain our energy, dull our senses, and deaden our joy."
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Greek verb for "dull" in this context. Replace «να μουντάρει τις αισθήσεις μας» with «να αμβλύνει τις αισθήσεις μας» to better convey the intended meaning.
findings.translation_quote: «...να μουντάρει τις αισθήσεις μας και να αμβλύνει τη χαρά μας.»
